connector.name: MCP Cloudflare DNS
connector.registryDescription: Cloudflare DNS MCP server: manage zones, records, cache purge, and page rules.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the Python package mcp-cloudflare-dns. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the ayo-fam account. Treat it as community software and read the source before granting access to anything sensitive.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: CF_API_TOKEN
env.description: Cloudflare API token with Zone DNS Edit, Zone Read, and Cache Purge permissions

env.name: CF_ALLOW_DESTRUCTIVE
env.description: Set to 'true' to enable DNS record deletion and full cache purge
